module.purpose: Manages live subscriptions to collection changes, handling ordered query optimization, duplicate prevention, and cursor-based incremental loading.
module.summary: The CollectionSubscriber class provides a live subscription mechanism for database collections, supporting ordered queries with index optimization. It tracks sent values to prevent duplicate inserts, manages cursor-based pagination for ordered loads, and integrates with a sync state system. The class handles status transitions, pending promise tracking, and coordinates between initial loads and change events.
module.businessContext: Enables real-time database synchronization for applications requiring live data updates. Failure breaks real-time UI updates and causes data inconsistency in collaborative applications.

units.name: loadNextItems

detail.name: loadNextItems
preconditions: subscription is a valid, active CollectionSubscription instance.
The query associated with the subscription has an orderBy operator with an index.
postconditions: The subscription's internal state is updated with the newly loaded items, if any.
The loading promise (this.pendingOrderedLoadPromise) is cleared upon completion or failure.
invariants: Only one load operation (loadNextItems or loadMoreIfNeeded) for a given subscription can be in progress at a time, enforced via this.pendingOrderedLoadPromise.
edgeCases: If no orderByInfo exists (no orderBy operator), the method returns immediately without loading.
If orderByInfo indicates no additional data is needed (dataNeeded is false), the method returns immediately.
If there is already a pending ordered load promise (this.pendingOrderedLoadPromise is set), the method returns that existing promise.
If the subscription's offset is beyond the total count of items, no new items are loaded.

errorPolicy.returnsOnError: The method may reject its promise. The pendingOrderedLoadPromise is cleared in a finally block.

stateMutations: Updates subscription.loadingPromise with the new loading promise.
Clears this.pendingOrderedLoadPromise in a finally block after the load operation completes.
detail.summary: Loads the next batch of items for a subscription to fetch more data, respecting any existing load promise to avoid concurrent fetches.

specTests.when: loadNextItems is called and no pending load exists.
specTests.then: A new loading promise is initiated and assigned to this.pendingOrderedLoadPromise, which will load the next batch and update subscription.offset.
The method returns without initiating a load or modifying subscription state.

specTests.then: The method returns the existing pendingOrderedLoadPromise without starting a new load.
